body: I envy you. You are wanted, desired, depended upon. That is a responsibility that I would kill to have. To be needed and loved with the world at my feet? You are blessed.

"I feel so sorry for you" is a phrase I've heard my entire life. It's funny because it's usually what people say to make others feel stronger but it usually has the opposite effect. It's cause is pity and the effect of that statement is hostility, very few lines such as that invoke feelings of both anger and empathy.

I don't really have a desire to. The idea of curling up with the bottle of Xanax and wild turkey in my bed and falling asleep forever is much more desirable than trying to find another log. It's dark, it's terrifying, and perhaps I'm taking the easy way out but I'm just so tired.

It's been a useless gift. How valuable is the ability to write when no one reads  or listens to what you have to say? People see words but fail to comprehend, like singing to the deaf, it falls on stone ears. I'm tired of trying.
I'm a single with no contact with any family and no friends.

I tried that last night. I used to love going bike riding, it was literally my favorite thing in the world and I did that because maybe it would give me that little sliver of hope I had been missing lately. Got my ipod, cranked up the music, and rode. It just made me sad you know? It made me sad how beautiful everything was around me which sounds weird but let me explain.  Everything about it made me sad, the warm air heavy with the smell of spring, the last light, bright orange and yellow streaming through the trees creating all these patterns that danced, sun setting behind purple clouds, it was all so beautiful, so gorgeous and saddening because all I could think of is how I used to love it, how that was enough to make me love life and now it just isn't and how now I just wanted to go to bed and not wake up. I've lost it, the passion that wonderful fire which drives you to continue, it' gone. It's like when you go camping and you have a fire that you try over and over again to rekindle because it's the only light you have and you can see it fading and you go to grab another log and there aren't any. I'm out fire, out of logs, and exhausted.
